desc: Nothing goes together quite like an AR-15 with a Schmeisser S60 polymer high-capacity stick magazine. The ATI Schmeisser S60 magazine is a standard aftermarket magazine. This magazine is for AR-15's chambered in 5.56 NATO or .223 Remington and holds 60 rounds of ammunition. It is made from high-quality polymer and the exterior of the magazine features a matte black finish. Additionally, it is worth noting that the magazine is made to Schmeisser's specifications and tolerances, using the same high-quality German manufacturing process and German materials to ensure not only a perfect fit, but exceptional operation.
